listDescription:
Returns a list of networks. For details on the format, see the
[network inspect endpoint](#operation/NetworkInspect).

Note that it uses a different, smaller representation of a network than
inspecting a single network. For example, the list of containers attached
to the network is not propagated in API versions 1.28 and up.

listParameters.name: filters
listParameters.description:
JSON encoded value of the filters (a `map[string][]string`) to process
on the networks list.

Available filters:

- `dangling=<boolean>` When set to `true` (or `1`), returns all
   networks that are not in use by a container. When set to `false`
   (or `0`), only networks that are in use by one or more
   containers are returned.
- `driver=<driver-name>` Matches a network's driver.
- `id=<network-id>` Matches all or part of a network ID.
- `label=<key>` or `label=<key>=<value>` of a network label.
- `name=<network-name>` Matches all or part of a network name.
- `scope=["swarm"|"global"|"local"]` Filters networks by scope (`swarm`, `global`, or `local`).
- `type=["custom"|"builtin"]` Filters networks by type. The `custom` keyword returns all user-defined networks.

inspectParameters.name: scope
inspectParameters.description: Filter the network by scope (swarm, global, or local)

Driver.description: Name of the IPAM driver to use.

Config.description:
List of IPAM configuration options, specified as a map:

```
{"Subnet": <CIDR>, "IPRange": <CIDR>, "Gateway": <IP address>, "AuxAddress": <device_name:IP address>}
```

Options.description: Driver-specific options, specified as a map.

JSON encoded value of the filters (a `map[string][]string`) to process
on the networks list.

Available filters:

- `dangling=<boolean>` When set to `true` (or `1`), returns all
   networks that are not in use by a container. When set to `false`
   (or `0`), only networks that are in use by one or more
   containers are returned.
- `driver=<driver-name>` Matches a network's driver.
- `id=<network-id>` Matches all or part of a network ID.
- `label=<key>` or `label=<key>=<value>` of a network label.
- `name=<network-name>` Matches all or part of a network name.
- `scope=["swarm"|"global"|"local"]` Filters networks by scope (`swarm`, `global`, or `local`).
- `type=["custom"|"builtin"]` Filters networks by type. The `custom` keyword returns all user-defined networks.

inspectParameters.name: scope
inspectParameters.description: Filter the network by scope (swarm, global, or local)

Id.description: ID that uniquely identifies a network on a single machine.

Created.description:
Date and time at which the network was created in
[RFC 3339](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc3339.txt) format with nano-seconds.

Scope.description:
The level at which the network exists (e.g. `swarm` for cluster-wide
or `local` for machine level)

Driver.description:
The name of the driver used to create the network (e.g. `bridge`,
`overlay`).

EnableIPv4.description: Whether the network was created with IPv4 enabled.

EnableIPv6.description: Whether the network was created with IPv6 enabled.

Internal.description:
Whether the network is created to only allow internal networking
connectivity.

Attachable.description:
Whether a global / swarm scope network is manually attachable by regular
containers from workers in swarm mode.

Ingress.description: Whether the network is providing the routing-mesh for the swarm cluster.

ConfigOnly.description:
Whether the network is a config-only network. Config-only networks are
placeholder networks for network configurations to be used by other
networks. Config-only networks cannot be used directly to run containers
or services.

Containers.description: Contains endpoints attached to the network.

Options.description: Network-specific options uses when creating the network.

Peers.description:
List of peer nodes for an overlay network. This field is only present
for overlay networks, and omitted for other network types.

Driver.description: Name of the IPAM driver to use.

Config.description:
List of IPAM configuration options, specified as a map:

```
{"Subnet": <CIDR>, "IPRange": <CIDR>, "Gateway": <IP address>, "AuxAddress": <device_name:IP address>}
```

Options.description: Driver-specific options, specified as a map.

listDescription:
Returns a list of networks. For details on the format, see the
[network inspect endpoint](#operation/NetworkInspect).

Note that it uses a different, smaller representation of a network than
inspecting a single network. For example, the list of containers attached
to the network is not propagated in API versions 1.28 and up.
